subject: Starter MAP package and slide proposal for Solstice pilot
messages:
From: Alex Grant <alex@solstice.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@solstice.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP templates + suggested close timeline

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency/cost guardrails. We're starting internal planning and would like a starter MAP you typically use for a 30- to 60-day pilot. Specifically:
- A template we can use (deliverables, acceptance criteria, owner lanes)
- Suggested kickoff & milestone cadence (tech validation, UX/QA, sign-off)
- A short slide deck we can use in an internal kickoff with our VP of Product

Can you share a GDoc + slides we can iterate on? We're aiming to start a pilot in early September and would like to lock the calendar this week.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Grant
Head of Product, Solstice AI
alex@solstice.ai

Attachment: none
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex@solstice.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP templates + suggested close timeline

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've attached our starter MAP template and a seed slide deck you can use for an internal kickoff. I've also created a collaborative GDoc with an initial draft tailored to the pilot scope you described. Link & attachments below.

Quick notes on approach:
- We keep acceptance criteria concrete and testable (example: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for the primary endpoint under the pilot traffic profile).
- Owner lanes: Product / Engineering / Security / Redwood CS — each week we list the deliverable and the test that proves it.
- Typical cadence: week 0 kickoff (workshop), week 1 tech validation, week 2 integration + run small smoke tests, week 3-4 feature validation and quality checks, week 5 acceptance & sign-off.

Proposed next steps this week:
1) You drop stakeholder names/roles into the GDoc (I've added a table).
2) We co-host a 60-min kickoff workshop (propose Wed 26 Aug or Fri 28 Aug).
3) We'll publish a 30-day milestone plan in the doc after the kickoff.

Docs/attachments: 
- Starter MAP template (attachment): MAP_Template_V1.gdoc (stub)
- Seed slides: MAP_Starter_Slides_v1.pptx (stub)
- Collaborative draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3MAPdraft (view/comment)

Attachment stubs: MAP_Template_V1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), MAP_Starter_Slides_v1.pptx (Slides stub)

Let me know which kickoff slot works and I'll send a calendar invite + draft agenda.

— Markus
Markus Klein | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Alex —

I pulled the MAP draft into a compact version for your VP-friendly kickoff (slide-friendly bullets + one-page acceptance table). I left two open rows in the acceptance table for any Solstice-specific KPIs you want to lock.

Notes on what I added:
- 'Tech validation' row includes: baseline perf test, model variant selection, and KV cache validation.
- 'Data & privacy' row lists audit log needs and a placeholder for retention policy confirmation (we can prefill once you share the compliance contact).
- Added a short risks section and rollback criteria so sign-off is clean.

Attachments referenced: Solstice_stakeholder_roster.pdf (please confirm the stakeholder list)
Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/4slidesMAPseed (editable)

Could you add:
- Primary acceptance metric (latency/cost/accuracy tradeoff)
- Who at Solstice will own security/compliance checks?

If we get that today, I can finalize the 30-day milestones before the kickoff.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
